source: Project: Self v2.3 via build spec v1.1, Appendix D.2 (week map from spec v1.1)

rows.title: Reliable, Scalable, and Maintainable Applications
rows.topics: Operational vs analytical systems; single-node vs distributed design. Latency percentiles, reliability, scalability, maintainability, operability.
rows.askOpsConnection: Choose a simple modular monolith before distributed services; explain operational vs analytical needs. Define load, latency, reliability, maintainability and operational limits for Ask-Ops.

rows.title: Data Models and Query Languages
rows.topics: Relational/document models, graphs, normalization, CQRS/event sourcing concepts.
rows.askOpsConnection: Domain entities, relational modeling, indexes, data access patterns and event/CQRS concepts.

rows.title: Storage and Retrieval
rows.topics: B-trees, LSM-trees, indexes, OLTP/analytics, vector embeddings.
rows.askOpsConnection: Storage engines, indexes, full-text/vector retrieval; justify only what the project uses.

rows.title: Encoding and Evolution
rows.askOpsConnection: Version API contracts or event schemas without breaking consumers.

rows.title: Replication
rows.askOpsConnection: Understand replication lag and stale reads; discuss before implementing replicas.

rows.title: Partitioning
rows.askOpsConnection: Explain partition-key choice and skew conceptually; do not shard this personal-scale project.

rows.title: Transactions
rows.topics: Isolation anomalies, serializability, write skew, distributed transactions.
rows.askOpsConnection: Protect inventory/order invariants, isolation and idempotent writes.

rows.title: The Trouble with Distributed Systems
rows.topics: Partial failures, unreliable networks/clocks, timeouts, leases.
rows.askOpsConnection: Timeouts, partial failures, clocks, retries and leases.

rows.title: Consistency and Consensus
rows.askOpsConnection: Know where strong consistency matters and why consensus is hard; do not implement consensus.

rows.title: Batch Processing
rows.askOpsConnection: Document ingestion, imports and offline processing.

rows.title: Stream Processing
rows.topics: Stream processing. A philosophy of streaming systems.
rows.askOpsConnection: Only add stream/broker patterns if there is a concrete event flow; compare batch and streaming.

rows.title: The Future of Data Systems
rows.topics: Includes "Doing the Right Thing": Privacy, access control, retention, auditability.
rows.askOpsConnection: Privacy, access control, retention, auditability and responsible use of business data.
